gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of cancer of any type and currently receiving cancer-targeted treatment or have received cancer-targeted treatment within 6 months of consent date based on self-report.

candidate_evidence.quote: The Elly mobile phone application delivers daily audio recording aimed at reducing anxiety, stress, loneliness, and social isolation.

coder_notes: Behavioural mobile-app intervention (Phase NA) for anxiety in patients with any cancer; no drug or biologic interventions.
